title: Deck drop: The Poet (INFP), four ways
caption:
The Poet (INFP) feels everything at full volume. What they do with it depends on their element.

Air INFPs share it and make friends. Fire INFPs start the petition. Water INFPs reread a comfort book every winter. Earth INFPs have kept a journal since they were 11.

Tag the Poet in your life. Which one are they?
